description.text:
The promos of Japan's Black & White years, numbered with a BW-P suffix and released from December 2010 to September 2013. The era began with Black Collection and White Collection, when L-P gave way to BW-P. Many came in Gym Challenge packs, month by month; others came with Pokémon Kids toys, Uniqlo shirts, Daiichi Pan bread, booster pack promotions, the Eevee Collection file, V Jump and CoroCoro Comic, and at the Battle Carnival and Summer Carnival events.

It is the only promo set with cancelled cards. 025/BW-P to 031/BW-P were meant for Japan's 2011 World Championship series, whose events were all cancelled after the Tōhoku earthquake of March 2011. Two were shown before the series was due to start, four more appeared in the official card database in 2012, and the last was found in 2020; how they would have been handed out is unknown.
